source: kernel loopback TCP on sandbox 2 vcpu, kernel, default mtu, throughput, TRN-10 session
notes: the client and the server host are sockets of one kernel that talk over the loopback interface of the host, in one process
the kernel runs the TCP timers and moves the segments, so there is no user space poll and idle_poll_us is zero by construction
bytes_per_socket is the growth of the resident set of the process, and kernel socket memory is not part of it
the stack has no frame counters, so frames and pump passes stay zero
every socket is a file descriptor, so the open files limit of the process caps the scaling run, and the report lists it as open_files_soft_limit
sockets counts both hosts of a pair and includes the listening sockets
